Today is National sea cucumber day in Blarfghanistan! To celebrate our national animal.

Today citizens all over Blarfghanistan take part in the 3 day celebration which includes a parade traveling from the westmost point in Blarfghanistan all the way to our beautiful eastern shore to then free a sea cucumber into our crystal ocean.

Another key part of these celebrations is a feast in the evening consisting of Wraps filled with whatever your heart desires. This dish celebrates and empathizes the uniqueness and individuality of every one of our citizens and marks a renewed oath by the Blarfghanistani government to honor and protect the peoples liberties when the president bites into his own during his sea cucumber day speech on national TV. 

We invite all our neighbors and brothers around the globe to cheer and celebrate this beautiful day together with our people! 

Glory to Blarfghanistan!
